description.mn: Agatho Parfum Castiamanti: Хүйс харгалзахгүй хув үнэр (EDP). Эхний ноот: гүргэм, лаврын навч, мирт; зүрхний ноот: сарнай, жасмин; суурь ноот: ваниль, агар мод, хүж, хув, лабданум, заар.
description.en: Castiamanti by Agatho Parfum is a Amber Vanilla fragrance for women and men. Castiamanti was launched in 2019. The nose behind this fragrance is Maurizio Cerizza. Top notes are Saffron, Laurels and Myrtle; middle notes are Rose and Jasmine; base notes are Vanilla, Agarwood (Oud), Incense, Amber, Labdanum and White Musk.
